files.description: Full rewrite of ShellEntry.tsx. Replaces platform TableView+DetailView with app-local TaskRow card list and TaskDetailEdit. Adds ThreeDotsMenu. Adds effort_hours to create form and detail edit.

local_types: interface TaskRow extends Row { id: string; title: string; description?: string; status: string; priority: string; due_date?: string; effort_hours?: number | null; created_at?: string; }

local_components.name: ThreeDotsMenu
local_components.props: { taskId: string; onMarkComplete: (id: string) => void; onDelete: (id: string) => void; }
local_components.behaviour: Renders ⋮ button; toggles dropdown with 'Mark complete' and 'Delete' items; closes on outside click via useRef+useEffect

local_components.name: TaskRow
local_components.props: { task: TaskRow; onOpen: (task: TaskRow) => void; onMarkComplete: (id: string) => void; onDelete: (id: string) => void; }
local_components.behaviour: Card container. Flex row: name (flex:1, truncate) | effort chip | priority chip | ThreeDotsMenu. onClick on card body (excluding three-dots zone) calls onOpen.
local_components.priority_display: Capitalised label with colour: high=error, medium=warning/amber, low=surface-variant

local_components.name: TaskDetailEdit
local_components.props: { task: TaskRow; onBack: () => void; onSaved: (updated: TaskRow) => void; }
local_components.behaviour: Pre-fills all fields from task prop. Calls PATCH /tasks/{id} on save. Calls onBack on cancel. Calls onSaved with updated row on success. Renders title (text), description (textarea), status (select), priority (select), due_date (date), effort_hours (number, min=0, step=0.5). Shows ErrorCard on API error. When building the PATCH body, always include effort_hours in the payload — if the user has cleared the effort input, send effort_hours: null explicitly (do not omit the key). This ensures the backend model_fields_set includes the field and the column is cleared.

main_component.name: TasksPage
handlers: handleMarkComplete(id) — PATCH /tasks/{id} {status:'done'} — optimistic update local state
handleDelete(id) — DELETE /tasks/{id} — filter from local state on success
handleSaved(updated) — replace task in local state by id
handleCreate(data) — POST /tasks — on success setCreating(false), fetchTasks()
